## Requirements

* R 4.1 or newer.
* The CRAN package `data.table` and the Bioconductor package `AnnotationDbi`.
* The annotation package for the species you use: `org.Hs.eg.db` for human,
  `org.Mm.eg.db` for mouse. You need only the one you use.

rsemverse is not on CRAN or Bioconductor. It is installed from GitHub.

## Install

`BiocManager` installs the packages from the right repositories, including the
Bioconductor ones:

```{r}
install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("DaikiKumakura/rsemverse")
```

Then the annotation package of your species:

```{r}
BiocManager::install("org.Hs.eg.db")   # human
BiocManager::install("org.Mm.eg.db")   # mouse
```

`rsem_read()` tells you which one is missing if you forget, and it prints the
command to install it.

## Check that it works

The package contains a small example that needs no files of your own:

```{r}
library(rsemverse)

ex <- system.file("extdata", "example", package = "rsemverse")
tpm <- rsem_read(
  data     = file.path(ex, "data"),
  metadata = file.path(ex, "metadata.csv"),
  species  = "human",
  expr     = "tpm"
)
head(tpm)
```

You should see a message beginning `rsem_read: 3 samples, 44 genes -> 43 rows`,
followed by a table with the columns `S1`, `S2` and `S3`.

## Versions and reproducibility

The gene symbols come from the installed annotation package, so the same input
can give slightly different symbols with different versions. The message that
`rsem_read()` prints includes the version of the annotation package; record it
with your results. `sessionInfo()` lists it as well.

## Troubleshooting the installation

| Message | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `there is no package called 'BiocManager'` | `install.packages("BiocManager")` first |
| The Bioconductor packages cannot be installed or are "built under a newer R" | Check that your R and Bioconductor versions go together (`BiocManager::valid()`) |
| `The package 'org.Hs.eg.db' is required` | `BiocManager::install("org.Hs.eg.db")` |
